Privacy Policy & Data Security
DPDP Act 2023 Compliant · Encrypted Storage
1. Absolute Farmer Ownership of Land Data
All cadastral land coordinates, survey numbers, and RoR passbooks remain the exclusive digital property of the registered farmer. NuKropAI does not sell or transfer land records.
2. On-Device Edge-AI Privacy
Crop disease scans and diagnostic images are processed locally on-device. Images uploaded to the community forum are stripped of private biometric identifiers.
3. Banking & KCC Loan Data Encryption
All financial ledgers and Kisan Credit Card information are encrypted with 256-bit AES encryption compliant with RBI and NABARD digital lending standards.
Terms of Service & Disclaimers
Agrarian AI Diagnostic & Market Guidelines
1. AI Crop Diagnostic Advisory
Neural disease detection models achieve over 98% field precision. However, farmers are advised to verify critical chemical dosages with local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) officers.
2. Real-Time Mandi Prices
APMC mandi prices and modal rates are synced directly with AGMARKNET. NuKropAI provides predictive rate trends as decision support.
